The '''Din supernova''' was the destruction of the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Din]].<ref name="Endor" /> Located in the [[Zuma sector/Legends|Zuma sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]],<ref name="EAOC Din">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Din system]]</ref> the star [[Supernova/Legends|exploded]]<ref name="Endor" /> around [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" /> The supernova vaporized any inner [[Planet/Legends|planets]] that could have [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] Din and boiled away the vast [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmospheres]] of the star's three outer [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giants]], leaving behind their exposed cores&mdash;one of which was a [[Diamond/Legends|diamond]] the size of a terrestrial world that had been formed by the intense pressure in the planet's atmosphere.<ref name="Endor" />

The supernova left behind the energetic [[Din Pulsar/Legends|Din Pulsar]] and the surrounding [[Din Nebula/Legends|Din Nebula]], which consisted of [[Color/Legends|red]] [[Gas/Legends|gases]]. According to a theory of the [[Ayrou/Legends|Ayrou]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of the [[Maya Kovel system/Legends|Maya Kovel system]], [[Death/Legends|deadly]] [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]] from the Din supernova eventually reached the [[Sanyassa system/Legends|Sanyassa system]], where the world [[Sanyassa IV]] was [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] to the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Sanyassan/Legends|Sanyassans]]. The event encoded itself in the [[DNA/Legends|DNA]] of the latter species, which was particularly susceptible to the ensuing [[Gene/Legends|genetic]] cataclysm. The Sanyassans subsequently recorded the supernova in their art and [[Music/Legends|songs]].<ref name="Endor" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Din supernova was first mentioned in the article "[[Endor and the Moddell Sector]]," which was published in the [[Star Wars Gamer 9|ninth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Gamer]]'' magazine<ref name="Endor" /> on [[February 22]], [[2002]].<ref name="GamerDate">{{SWArchive|url=gaming/other/rpg/news20020222.html|text=Starfighters Soar in Gamer #9}}</ref>
